title: Hyderabad protest condemns alleged harassment of female journalist by Delhi Police

tea.why: Protesters condemned the alleged sexual harassment of a female journalist by a Delhi Police ACP during protests in the national capital.
tea.want: Participants demanded legal action and the arrest of the Delhi Police officer involved, as well as an FIR regarding the matter.
tea.changed: Oct 4: Residents, students, and civil society activists staged a demonstration at People's Plaza in Hyderabad.

summary: On October 4, 2026, residents, students, and civil society members gathered at People's Plaza on Necklace Road in Hyderabad to protest the alleged sexual assault of a female journalist by Delhi Police ACP Vivek Bhagat. Organised by groups including the Disha Students Organisation and the Women's Liberation League, the demonstration featured speakers who condemned police violence, patriarchy, and the failure to register an FIR over the incident. Protesters raised slogans, questioned women's safety under government initiatives, and criticized broader crackdowns on freedom of expression and democratic rights. The gathering drew weekend crowds near Necklace Road before concluding.
demands: Arrest of Delhi Police ACP Vivek Bhagat
Registration of an FIR regarding the alleged assault
Protection of women's safety and fundamental democratic rights
response: No official response reported iniformes or sources.

updates.text: A citizens' protest was held at People's Plaza in Hyderabad to condemn the alleged assault of a woman journalist by a Delhi Police officer.
